cands.bio: Republican state senator for Alabama Senate District 12 (Calhoun County and eastern Talladega County) since November 2022. Realtor and business owner, he was president of Harris-McKay Realty and of the Alabama Association of Realtors, and served on the National Association of Realtors board.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Kelley grew up or when he began living in Alabama as an adult. We found no documented actions or stated positions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land protection, immigration and H-1B, police pay and public order, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no public statements from him about data centers or development. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026, and no controversies or foreign ties appeared in the pages we read. His campaign site describes bills he sponsored (a firearm storage bill, a social work licensure compact, and local halfway-house legislation) and a grocery tax vote. None of these were checked against legislative records, and none map clearly onto the issues voters asked about.

qual.why: He has held a legislative office and has run a business, which puts him toward the upper end of the range. The record is one term in the Senate and no law, policy-staff or budget career.
